metadata.title: feat(api): add per-gateway health check toggle
metadata.author: kimsehwan96

description: ## 🔗 Related Issue Closes #3867 --- ## 📝 Summary Add a per-gateway `health_check_enabled` toggle that allows administrators to disable health checks on individual gateways. When disabled, the gateway and its tools are immediately marked as reachable, and the health check loop skips the gateway. This prevents OAuth `authorization_code` gateways from being falsely marked offline when the `platform_admin_email` has no valid token on the external OAuth provider. --- ## 🏷️ Type of Change - [ ] Bug fix - [x] Feature / Enhancement - [ ] Documentation - [ ] Refactor - [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling) - [ ] Other (describe below) --- ## 🧪 Verification | Check | Command | Status | |---------------------------|-----------------|--------| | Lint suite | `make lint` | pass | | Unit tests | `make test` | pass | | Coverage ≥ 80% | `make coverage` | | ### Manual E2E (docker-compose) 1. Fresh `docker compose up` with clean DB — verified Alembic migration applies cleanly (`b46886f8f835`, `server_default=sa.true()`) 2. Add form: "Enable Health Checks" checkbox present and checked by default 3. Edit form: checkbox reflects saved DB state (tested both `true` and `false`) 4. Changed gateway URLs to invalid ports(test purpose) → health check detected failure → gateway + tools went offline 5. Toggled health check off via UI → gateway + tools immediately became reachable 6. Verified health check loop skips gateways with `health_check_enabled=False` --- ## ✅ Checklist - [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`) - [x] Tests added/updated for changes - [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable) - [x] No secrets or credentials committed --- ## 📓 Notes (optional) **Note on `set_gateway_state()` reuse:** The issue mentions leveraging `set_gateway_state(only_update_reachable=True)` for the toggle-to-online behavior. However, `set_gateway_state(activate=True, reachable=True)` triggers `_initialize_gateway` regardless of `only_update_reachable`, which can cause unintended side effects for OAuth auth_code gateways (see #3881). Instead, the reachable update is done directly in `update_gateway()` using the same bulk UPDATE pattern that `set_gateway_state` uses internally. - Follows existing `enabled`/`reachable` boolean column pattern - Edit form checkbox has no HTML `checked` attribute — JS populates from API response (`healthCheckEnabled` camelCase) - Unchecked checkbox detection: `"health_check_enabled" in form` (HTML checkbox omits field when unchecked) - Bulk tool reachable update uses existing `db.execute(update(DbTool))` pattern (same as `set_gateway_state`)

commits.message:
feat(api): add per-gateway health check toggle

Add health_check_enabled field to gateways, allowing administrators to
disable health checks on individual gateways where the platform admin
has no valid OAuth credentials on the external provider.

When disabled:
- Gateway and tools are immediately set to reachable=True
- Health check loop skips the gateway
- Prevents false-negative offline status for OAuth auth_code gateways

Includes DB migration, Admin UI checkbox, unit tests, and Playwright
E2E tests.

Closes: #3867

Signed-off-by: kimsehwan96 <sktpghks138@gmail.com>
